rules.statement: A nomination paper must be rejected if it does not bear the signature of the Secretary of the Party as required by section 30.
rules.supporting_quote: The requirement of section 28(5) of the Ordinance as to the signature and the rejecting of the nomination paper where the signature of the Secretary of the Party does not appear, required by section 30(1 )(e) of the Ordinance are mandatory and calls for proper compliance

rules.statement: Proper compliance with the provisions of the Ordinance is required.
